instruct_8: English constituency parsing involves analyzing a sentence's grammatical structure by identifying its constituent phrases (e.g., noun phrases, verb phrases) and their hierarchical relationships.  The task is challenging due to structural constraints and the often significantly longer output compared to the input sentence.  RNN-based sequence-to-sequence models have struggled to achieve top performance, especially with limited training data.
